name: Test Project
summary: Development fixture with a deliberately rich document: multiple content sections, nested objects, arrays, advantages and disadvantages, audience guidance, a verdict, several links and several sources. It stress-tests the generic renderer.

content.introduction:
This development fixture exists to push the generic renderer harder than any other test document. It mixes prose, string arrays, nested objects and arrays of objects.

It deliberately contains a second paragraph so that paragraph splitting on blank lines can be verified.
content.what_is_it: A fictional project used to verify that deeply structured JSON renders as readable documentation without any resource-specific code.

how_does_it_work.overview: Nested objects become sub-sections with their own headings.

architecture.description: A single generic renderer shared by every resource.
Dynamic /library/{id}/ paths with no physical directory.

advantages: Easy to review in a pull request
disadvantages: Large documents load as a single file
Schema errors surface only at runtime
content.verdict: If every section on this page is readable, correctly nested and free of raw JSON, the generic renderer is behaving as intended.
